id./param/scenario/cs/c_010_cs_010.pack|cs_:
"This is the Tree's soul...
  I feel like I've never seen it before.
  Nostalgic, yet frightening...

"Hmm... Strange.
  I feel like I've been here
  a long time ago too.

"All the world's lives gather here, right?
  Maybe memories from before we were born
  still linger...

"Eek! What's this!?
  Something zapped me away!

"Hmm... As I thought, only someone with
  the Luminary's mark can enter
  the Tree's soul.

"And that is what dispels darkness...
  It must be the Sword of Light.

"Now, {var:1}!
  Take the Sword of Light inside
  the Tree's soul!

"You... you should be able
  to take it!

{var:1} remembered
what once happened
in this place...!

Incredible!
The Sword of Shadows glows eerily,
as if answering something!

{var:1} cut through Jasper's attack
with the Sword of Shadows!
"What... you! What did you just do!?
"Jasper! When did you follow us!?

"I have no words for a sewer rat
  who didn't notice being followed!
  My only aim is {var:1}!
"What was that...!?

"Mind your manners, Princess Jade.
  To me you're one sacrifice among many
  in the calamity to come...

"Impossible...!
  You cut through the dark aura...!?
"What is that sword...!

"Curse you...! Do you think one sword
  can defeat me!?

"Devil's Child {var:1}, and you who ally
  with him! I'll make this World Tree
  your tombstone!
